title: Binary one-degree quotient of a supplied perfect-source coefficient factorization
statement:
Let $D$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $D\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, and let $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}D$ be separated and of finite type [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. For every quasi-compact open subscheme $W\subseteq Y$ [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], put $\mathcal B_W=\mathcal O_W\otimes_D R_A$ and use $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal B_W)$, the forgetful functor $U_W$, perfection, $\widehat K$, and the coefficient constructions of [def-sfb-dg-coefficient-realization] on $W$. For a commutative $D$-algebra $E$ with a specified map $E\to A$, put $W_E=W\times_D\operatorname{Spec}E$ and let $\pi_{W,E}:W_A\to W_E$ be the projection [def-pc-fibre-product]; write $\Phi^W_E$ and $\nu^W_E$ for those coefficient constructions.

Define $\mathscr P(W)$ as the following uniform assertion. For every perfect $H\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal B_W)$, every $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{W_A})$ [def-pc-derived-category], every $m\in\mathbf Z$, and every morphism $u:H\to\widehat K$ such that $H^i(U_Wu)$ is surjective as a morphism of sheaves for every $i\ge m$, there exist a commutative finite type $D$-algebra $E$ with $D\to E\to A$, an object $G\in D(\mathcal O_{W_E})$ with bounded coherent cohomology [pqf-def-coherent], an ordinary scheme-derived morphism $\gamma:G\to R\pi_{W,E*}K$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and a morphism $\sigma:H\to\Phi^W_E(G)$ in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal B_W)$ such that $\nu^W_E(\gamma)\circ\sigma=u$ and $H^i(U_W\sigma)$ is surjective for every $i\ge m$.

Let $O,V\subseteq Y$ be quasi-compact open subschemes, with $V$ affine [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and $O\cap V$ quasi-compact, and set $W=O\cup V$. Assume the three uniform assertions $\mathscr P(O)$, $\mathscr P(V)$, and $\mathscr P(O\cap V)$. Fix a perfect $H\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal B_W)$, an ordinary $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{W_A})$, a morphism $u:H\to\widehat K$, and an integer $r$. Suppose that a finite type commutative $D$-algebra $E$ with $D\to E\to A$, a bounded-coherent $G\in D(\mathcal O_{W_E})$, an ordinary $\gamma:G\to R\pi_{W,E*}K$, and $s:H\to\Phi^W_E(G)$ are supplied, with $\nu^W_E(\gamma)s=u$. Assume $H^i(U_Ws)$ is surjective for all $i>r$, and $H^i(U_Wu)$ is surjective for all $i\ge r$.

Then there exist a commutative finite type $E$-algebra $E'$ with $E\to E'\to A$ extending the supplied map, a bounded-coherent $G'\in D(\mathcal O_{W_{E'}})$, an ordinary $\gamma':G'\to R\pi_{W,E'*}K$, and $s':H\to\Phi^W_{E'}(G')$ such that $\nu^W_{E'}(\gamma')s'=u$ and $H^i(U_Ws')$ is surjective for every $i\ge r$. The local uniform assertions are for the original base $D\to A$; they are not assumed anew for $E\to A$. No compatibility of local witnesses or restriction of the output witness to the supplied $G$ is required. This is a one-degree improvement of a supplied global factorization, not an assertion that an initial global factorization exists.

from.place: det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images, proof (3), alteration reduction through ILO X Lemma 2.2: dimension induction in the marked plurinodal input; one relative curve, de Jong Theorem 2.4, Lemmas 5.5 and 5.7, before induction on its base; replacement prerequisite: de Jong Lemma 3.7, printed p.608, including the prime-to-characteristic level-structure choice which makes the base alteration generically etale; §3.6 supplies the smooth genus-at-least-two input. This is stable pointed-curve extension, not stable modification of a specified target pair. Moduli prerequisite: projective compactification with prime-to-characteristic level structure and its universal stable family, used before taking the closure of a generic lift. Knudsen forgetful morphism as the universal stable curve. Section 1, Theorem 1.8, Corollaries 1.9 and 1.11; Section 2, Proposition 2.1 (printed pp.172--175): degree-zero logarithmic components and their section-algebra contraction. Independent prerequisite: Cohomology and log dualizing comparison for a given elementary nodal contraction. Logarithmic comparison before Knudsen Lemma 1.6: generic coherent-duality trace on a perfect marking ideal, replacing the differential-dual presentation by the same adjunction-normalized relative duality. Prerequisite for the perfect-image coherent trace comparison: locality on affine opens for the proper map between the two curve families, without asserting that this map is flat. Independent prerequisite: Pseudo-coherent perfect direct images between flat finitely presented families. Kiehl finiteness input: the unnumbered general relative-pseudo-coherence assertion following Stacks lemma-flat-proper-pseudo-coherent-direct-image-general. Finite-degree Noetherian descente input for the Kiehl finiteness assertion. Independent prerequisite: Relative sheaf descente on a prescribed Noetherian envelope. Two-open gluing prerequisite, conditional on approximation on both opens and their intersection, uniform in a supplied finite coefficient stage. Single-degree induction step: cancel finite polynomial-chart top obstructions globally while retaining the prescribed scalar-action normalization. Mayer--Vietoris subproblem for one degree: given a global coherent witness at cutoff n+1 and witnesses on two opens at cutoff n, obtain a global witness at cutoff n. The supplied global witness is part of the hypothesis. Independent input: finite coherent factorization of a cohomologically surjective perfect dg arrow to an ordinary scheme complex, with cohomologically surjective first factor. Uniform Mayer--Vietoris locality step: the predicate on each open covers all perfect sources, ordinary targets, integer cutoffs and arrows surjective on cohomology above the cutoff; conditional on this full predicate on both opens and their intersection. Independent prerequisite: single-degree improvement of a supplied global factorization; finite downward induction supplies uniform locality.
